senses.gloss:
शय्या, f. a bed, couch, sofa; tying, stringing to-
gether, winding.
—शय्या-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to
bed, lying in bed or on a couch, confined to bed.
—शय्याच्छादन (˚या-आच्˚), अम्, n. a bed-cover-
ing, counterpane, sheet.
—शय्याध्यक्ष (˚या-
अध्˚), अस्, m. = शय्या-पाल.
—शय्या-पतित, अस्, आ,
अम्, = शय्या-गत.
—शय्या-पाल, अस्, m. the super-
intendent of beds or sleeping apartments at the court
of a Hindū prince, guardian of a king's bed-chamber.
—शय्यापाल-त्व, अम्, n. the office of guarding a
king's bed-chamber.
—शय्योत्सङ्ग (˚या-उत्˚), अस्,
m. the side or edge of a bed; (according to some)
the middle of a bed.

शाय शाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. शी), lying,
sleeping.
सय स-य, अस्, आ, अम्, with the letter य.

साय साय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. सो, cf. अव-सो,
1. अव-साय, दिवसावसान), end, close, termina-
tion; the close of day, evening; an arrow; (अम्),
ind. the evening; Evening personified as a son of
Puṣpārṇa and Prabhā [cf. प्रातर्, मध्यन्-
दिन]; in the evening; (ए), ind. in the evening,
at the close of day; [cf. according to some, Lat.
serus, but recent authorities refer serus to rt. सृ.]
—सायं-सन्ध्या, f. the evening twilight; the
goddess to be worshipped at the evening twilight
or the time at which she is worshipped.
—सायं-
सन्ध्या-देवता, f. ‘the deity of the evening twi-
light,’ epithet of Sarasvatī.
—सायङ्-काल, अस्, m.
evening, eventide.
—सायङ्कालीन, अस्, आ, अम्, be-
longing to evening, vespertine.
—सायङ्-गृह, अस्,
m., N. of a Muni.
—सायन्-धृति, इस्, f. the even-
ing Homa or oblation.
—सायन्-निवास, अस्, m.
evening abode, evening resting-place.
—साय-मण्-
डन, अम्, n. ‘evening-ornament,’ sunset.
—सायम्-
अधिवास, अस्, m. ‘evening-decoration,’ N. of the
ceremony of decorating an image of Durgā on the
fifth day of the month Āśvina.
—सायाह्न (˚य-
अह्˚), अस्, m. the evening, eventide.
साय, अस्, m. end, close, &c. See p. 1109, col. 1.

शयण्ड, अस्, ई, अम्, sleeping, asleep, sleepy;
(अस्), m., N. of a place.
—शयण्ड-भक्त, अस्,
m., N. of a district, the district of Śayaṇḍa.

शयथ, अस्, आ, अम्, sleepy, asleep, sleeping; (अस्),
m. death, dying; a sort of snake, the boa constric-
tor; a boar; a fish.

शयन, अम्, n. lying down, sleeping, reposing,
sleep; a bed, couch; copulation.
—शयन-गृह,
अम्, n. ‘sleeping-house,’ a bed-chamber.
—शयन-
सखी, f. a bed-fellow.
—शयन-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
being or reclining on a couch.
—शयन-स्थान,
अम्, n. a sleeping-place, sleeping-apartment.
—शय-
नागार (˚न-आग्˚), अस्, m. a sleeping-room, bed-
chamber.
—शयनैकादशी (˚न-एक्˚), f. the eleventh
day of the light half of month Āṣāḍha (on which
Viṣṇu's sleep commences).

शयान, अस्, आ, अम्, lying down, reclining, resting,
sleeping, slumbering, asleep.

सयन सयन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. सि), the act
of binding, fastening; [cf. प्र-स्˚.]

सायन सायन (स-अय्˚), अम्, n. the longi-
tude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equi-
noctial point.

शयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be slept, to be lain on,
fit or suitable for sleep; (अम्), n. a bed, couch.
शयनीय, शयित, &c. See p. 994, col. 1.
शयनीयक, अम्, n. a bed, couch.

शयानक, अस्, m. a kind of snake, the boa con-
strictor; a chameleon, lizard.

शयालु, उस्, उस्, उ, sleepy, slothful, sluggish; (उस्),
m. the boa snake; a dog; a jackal.

शयित, अस्, आ, अम्, reposed, lying, sleeping,
asleep; (अस्), m. the plant Cordia Myxa; (अम्), n.
sleep, sleeping.
—शयित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who
has lain down, gone to sleep, sleeping, asleep.
शयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lain or slept.
शयित्वा, ind. having lain down, having slept.
शयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lying, resting, reposing.

शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lying down, reclining, sleeping,
resting, abiding, (अधः-शायिन्, sleeping on the
ground; एक-शायिन्, sleeping alone.)

सायिन् सायिन्, ई, m. (according to some)
a horseman (= अश्वारोह; cf. सादिन्).

शयुत्रा, ind., Ved. on or to a couch, (Sāy. =
शयने, Ṛg-veda X. 40, 2); in or to a dwelling-
place, (Sāy. = शयने, निवास-स्थाने, Ṛg-veda I.
117, 12.)
शयुन, अस्, m. a large snake, the boa constrictor.

शय्यम्-भव, अस्, m., N. of one of the six
Śruta-kevalins (with Jainas).

1. शायक, अस्, इका, अम्, lying, sleeping, reposing;
(इका), f. sleeping, repose, sleep.

शायक 2. शायक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शो), an
arrow; a sword; [cf. सायक.]
शायक. See s. v.

सायक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. destroying; (अस्), m.
an arrow [cf. 2. शायक]; a sword, any weapon, a
thunderbolt, (enumerated among the वज्र-नामानि
in Naigh. II. 20); (इका), f. the being or standing
in regular order, = क्रम-स्थिति; (अम्), n., Ved.
an arrow.
—सायक-पुङ्खा, f. the feathered end
of an arrow.
—सायक-प्रणुत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, driven
away by arrows, put to flight by arrows.
—सायक-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of arrows.
सय् सय्, cl. 1. A. सयते, &c., to go.

सयक्ष्मन् स-यक्ष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, having or
subject to consumption, consumptive.

सयन्त्र स-यन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, with machines.
—स-यन्त्र-जल-शैल, अस्, आ, अम्, having engines
and water and a rock.

सयावक स-यावक, अस्, आ (according to
some इका), अम्, dyed or coloured with lac.

सयावन् स-यावन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. going
along with, attendant, attending, associated with
(with inst.).
सयुज् स-युज्, क्, m., Ved. a companion.

स-युग्वन्, आ, आ or अरी, अ, Ved. associated with,
attending on, attendant; (आ), m. a proper N.

स-युज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, closely united with.
—स-
युज्य-ता, f. intimate union or junction.

सायुज्य सायुज्य, अम्, n. (fr. स-युज्), inti-
mate union, identification, absorption (especially into
the divine essence; this is one of the four or five
grades or states into which Mukti is distinguished;
cf. ब्रह्म-स्˚); similarity, likeness; [cf. राज-स्˚.]

सयुधिष्ठिर स-युधिष्ठिर, अस्, आ, अम्, with
or accompanied by Yudhiṣṭhira.

सयूथ्य स-यूथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to
the same herd or tribe; (अस्), m. one of the same
tribe.

सयोग स-योग, अम्, n. (scil. गुण-स्थान),
epithet of the last but one of the fourteen stages
leading to final emancipation (according to the belief
of the Jainas).

सयोनि स-योनि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the same
womb, uterine; closely related to; closely united
with the womb; (इस्), m. ‘being from the same
womb,’ a brother; a pair of nippers for cutting
betel-nut; N. of Indra (according to some).

सयोषण स-योषण, अस्, आ, अम्, attended
by women, along with the women.
सायकायन, अस्, m. a proper N.

सायन्तन, अस्, ई, अम् [cf. चिरन्तन], belonging
to evening, vespertine.

सायण सायण or सायणाचार्य (˚ण-आच्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a learned Brāhman (thought to have
flourished about A. D. 1370, and celebrated as a
well-known commentator on the Ṛg-veda, Śata-
patha-Brāhmaṇa, Tāṇḍya-Brāhmaṇa, and other
works; he was associated in many of his writings
with his elder brother Mādhava, also called Vidyā-
raṇya, who became prime minister to two kings,
Bukka-rāya and Harihara, after having aided them
to found a new capital, called Vijaya-nagara, in the
native kingdom of Karnāṭa about A. D. 1344).

सायणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or composed
by Sāyaṇa.
सायवस सायवस, अस्, m. a proper N.

सायुध सायुध (स-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having
weapons, armed.
—सायुध-प्रग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्,
holding weapons in the hand.
